I don’t have real‑time weather data, but I can give you a quick snapshot of what Hanoi usually looks like around this time of year.

| Month | Typical High (°C) | Typical Low (°C) | Rainfall | Notes |
|-------|-------------------|------------------|----------|-------|
| **Jan** | 18–20 | 7–9 | 70 mm | Cool, dry, clear skies |
| **Feb** | 20–22 | 8–10 | 80 mm | Still cool, occasional showers |
| **Mar** | 23–26 | 11–13 | 120 mm | Warm, more rain |
| **Apr** | 27–30 | 15–17 | 140 mm | Hot, humid, frequent showers |
| **May** | 29–32 | 18–20 | 170 mm | Very hot, high humidity |
| **Jun** | 30–33 | 20–22 | 200 mm | Start of monsoon, heavy rain |
| **Jul** | 31–34 | 22–24 | 250 mm | Peak monsoon, heavy rainfall |
| **Aug** | 31–34 | 22–24 | 260 mm | Heavy rain, high humidity |
| **Sep** | 30–33 | 20–22 | 210 mm | Monsoon still strong |
| **Oct** | 27–30 | 16–18 | 140 mm | Cooler, less rain |
| **Nov** | 23–26 | 12–14 | 90 mm | Dry, mild |
| **Dec** | 19–21 | 8–10 | 70 mm | Cool, dry |

If you’re planning a trip or just curious about today’s conditions, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the local meteorological service) for the most up‑to‑date forecast. Let me know if you’d like help finding a specific forecast or anything else!
